data.fund_type: An open-ended equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, small cap stocks
data.investment_objective: To generate capital appreciation by investing in equity and equity related securities. However, there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be realized.
data.asset_allocation: Equity & Equity Related Instruments - 65% to 100% (Risk- High) Debt and money- market instruments - 0% to 35% (Risk- Low to medium) Invits- 0% to 10% (Risk- Medium to High) Pursuant to SEBI Circular dated November 28, 2025, AMFI shall include REITs in the list of classification of scrips as per their market capitalization.
data.fund_managers: Mr. Shridatta Bhandwaldar / Mr. Pranav Gokhale
data.exit_load: 1% - if redeemed/switched out within 1 year from the date of allotment. Nil – if redeemed / switched out after 1 year from the date of allotment.
